# Ranjitha Sathiaraj — Portfolio
# Senior User Assistance Developer, SAP Asset Performance Management
# https://ranjithasathiarajs.github.io

## Who this is

Ranjitha Sathiaraj is a Senior User Assistance Developer at SAP, focused on SAP Asset Performance Management (APM).
Her work sits at the intersection of technical writing, content effectiveness analysis, and AI documentation.

She does not just produce documentation. She measures whether it works, uses data to find what is missing,
and builds content that deflects support tickets before customers need to raise them.

## What this portfolio covers

This portfolio contains case studies, methodology pages, and live artifacts across four domains:

### 1. AI Documentation
- Documenting AI agents for SAP Joule (responsible AI, data privacy, scope and limitations, example prompts)
- A 17-section documentation architecture built for SAP APM Joule agents
- RAG quality audits: identifying where enterprise documentation fails in retrieval-augmented generation systems
- A RAG Readiness Audit Framework: 5-phase repeatable methodology with scoring rubric
- A business case for RAG-ready content: cost models, ticket deflection volumes, rewrite scope

### 2. Content Effectiveness Measurement
- Task Completion Rate (TCR): exit survey data from SAP Help Portal visitors, tracked quarterly
- Self-Service Rate (SSR): visits from SAP for Me to Help Portal, measuring whether content satisfies need
- Helpful Sentiment (HS): thumbs-up vote tracking on Help Portal pages
- Q2 vs Q3 2026 quarterly analysis: volume doubled in Q3 (48 to 106 visits), content held up

### 3. Support Ticket Deflection (TCO Reduction)
- ISQM analysis of SAP APM support tickets to find documentation gaps and recurring patterns
- 297 additional tickets identified as deflectable through targeted doc improvements
- A custom Claude Code agent (TCO Tree Content Agent) built to automate support tree content drafting
- Estimated cost recovery: €6,475 per year from content improvements

### 4. Technical Writing and UX Review
- UI/UX review of a 16-screen workflow (Implement Recommendations, SAP APM): 62 findings
- Error message review: system strings audited against SAP enterprise writing standards
- Release documentation for 2611: Consequence Assessments app (10 topics from scratch), asset-specific task lists

## Tools and methods used

- Adobe Analytics (page visits, bounce rates, search term analysis)
- Task Completion Reporting 1.0 (SAC story, SAP Analytics Cloud)
- Self-Service Reporting Tool 2.0 (SAC story)
- UA Feedback Dashboard (SharePoint, UA KPIs page)
- ISQM (SAP internal support ticket analysis)
- Claude Code (custom AI agents, data pipelines, dashboard generation)
- Confluence Wiki (SAP internal documentation platform)
- SAP Help Portal (help.sap.com)

## Roles this profile fits

Strong fit:
- Senior User Assistance Developer or Senior Technical Writer (enterprise SaaS)
- Content Strategist with analytics focus
- AI Documentation Specialist
- Information Architect (documentation systems, topic structures)

Not a fit for:
- Pure API reference or SDK documentation roles
- Consumer product or B2C content
- DevRel or developer advocacy
- Video or multimedia content production
